path.data-section-name: 117 - LEXUS SIDELINE CLUB - Features wider, padded seats with access to a private air-conditioned club below your seats. The club features a full-bar, a carving station and other ala-carte food options as well as a private entrance at the north entrance gate.
111T - CORNER TERRACE - Features half-moon tables with cushioned swivel chairs. Corner Terraces are in the 100 level, but have access to the air-conditioned club level.
